sections.h2: India already makes LAB, and Indian Oil's unit is the largest reported

chart.title: Indian Oil's LAB unit is the largest reported, at 162,000 tonnes a year
chart.sub: LAB capacity by producer, tonnes a year.
chart.source: Indian Oil investor presentation; Tamilnadu Petroproducts; post sources.

sections.means: Two domestic producers have reported capacity, and TPL says its LAB sits in roughly 40% of India's fabric detergents.
sections.todo: Track whether Reliance and ONGC Petro publish capacity figures, since none were found for them.

sections.h2: Detergent makers run a small surplus, while LAB imports far outweigh exports

chart.title: Alkylbenzene imports outweigh exports by ₹3,649 crore, the largest gap
chart.sub: Trade balance by HS line, FY2024-25, ₹ crore (positive is surplus).
chart.source: DGCI&S 8-digit trade lines, as cited in the post.

sections.means: Finished detergents are in surplus, but the chemicals that feed them are imported in large amounts.
sections.todo: Check whether FY2025-26 alkylbenzene imports keep rising, as the post's updated trade figures suggest.

sections.h2: Domestic SAP output is a sliver of a market of about 50,000 tonnes

chart.title: BPCL's 200-tonne demo plant is a fraction of national SAP demand

sections.means: India can now make SAP at small scale, but nearly all of its demand is still met by imports.
sections.todo: Watch for the commissioning of BPCL's planned 50,000-tonne commercial SAP plant, which has no confirmed date.
